data.name: Loyal Bodyguard
data.description: A protector gains Bodyguard and Combat Reflexes as bonus feats. If the familiar is sharing its master's square, it can use Bodyguard to aid another to improve its master's AC even if it doesn't threaten the attacking foe, though it still needs line of effect to its master and the attacker.
